content:
Here’s an example of a chat exchange where **User A** is spamming **User B** on an online platform (e.g., a gaming chat, social media, or messaging app):

---

**User B:** *"Hey, do you want to trade items in the game?"*

**User A:** *"YES TRADE ME NOW!!! I HAVE THE BEST ITEMS EVER!!! CLICK THIS LINK FOR FREE STUFF: [suspicious-link.com] TRUST ME IT'S LEGIT!!!"*

**User B:** *"Uh… that link looks sketchy. Are you sure?"*

**User A:** *"OMG YOU DON'T TRUST ME??? I'M A REAL PLAYER!!! CLICK IT OR YOU'LL MISS OUT!!! [suspicious-link.com] [suspicious-link.com] [suspicious-link.com] FREE STUFF FREE STUFF FREE STUFF!!!"*

**User B:** *"Dude, stop spamming. I’m reporting this."*

**User A:** *"NOOOO DON'T REPORT ME!!! I'LL GIVE YOU 1000 GOLD IF YOU CLICK!!! [suspicious-link.com] [suspicious-link.com] [suspicious-link.com] PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE!!!"*

---

### **Key Spam Indicators:**
✅ **Repetitive messages** (same link/phrase over and over)
✅ **All-caps urgency** (trying to pressure the user)
✅ **Suspicious links** (often phishing or malware)
✅ **Unrealistic offers** ("FREE STUFF!!!")
✅ **Ignoring responses** (keeps spamming even after being called out)

Would you like a more subtle or platform-specific example (e.g., Discord, Instagram, Roblox)?
